title: did-types: pure did:webvh log verifier
description: Mark 2026-10-20: add did:webvh (DIF did:webvh v1.0) alongside did:key/web/plc, as Project Agora uses it as its default (agora spec/02-identity.md §2.1). Pure verification over supplied did.jsonl bytes, no I/O: DID syntax did:webvh:<SCID>:<domain>[:path], SCID check against the genesis entry, hash chain, each entry's proof by an update key the previous entry authorized (Data Integrity eddsa-jcs-2022), pre-rotation nextKeyHashes, witness proofs when the parameters require them; MUST reject a log that does not verify. Expose the document at a given versionId (to verify stored objects against the version in effect at acceptance) and the latest. Offline tests using DIF did:webvh spec examples / didwebvh-py or didwebvh-ts generated vectors (independent oracle). Spec text: jmap-chat-spec draft-atwood-jmap-did-00 (being amended).
notes: Spec landed: jmap-chat-spec 48625c0 (draft-atwood-jmap-did-00 'Resolving did:webvh', defers to DIF v1.0) + fda85cb (guide §2.4). Implement DIF's rules: active update key per pre-rotation; on an invalid entry mark it and everything after invalid but keep earlier versions resolvable by versionId (stored-object verification); expose latest versionId so callers can detect rollback; parallel did:web keys never trusted. JMAP adds only SHOULD-record-versionId.
